about_the_game:
A Wonderful, Wicked World Awaits

Shyftrs is a 2D hand-drawn single-player Metroidvania adventure, blending dark fantasy with mythic storytelling and stylish visuals. Inspired by legends and cultures across history, it invites players into a vibrant, mysterious world where every step forward uncovers secrets buried in time.

You’ll take on the role of Brams, a young apprentice from the prestigious House of Corvin—one of Esos’ most renowned families of explorers. When your parents vanish during a secret expedition, your search for answers leads you through an unimaginable twist of fate: you’re suddenly transported to Ikarus, a strange and beautiful world.

As Brams, you’ll explore the mythical lands of Ikarus and its hidden dimension—the Astral World, a surreal bridge between Ikarus and Esos. Along your journey, you’ll unravel the truth of your family’s legacy, uncover your mysterious ancestry, and face creatures and powers that defy reason.

Will you return to Esos… or will Ikarus reshape your destiny forever?


🔥 Key Features

  • 🎨 Stylized Hand-Drawn Art
    Every character, creature, and landscape is meticulously illustrated by hand, creating a world that feels both sketched and alive.

  • 🌍 Interconnected Realms to Explore
    Traverse the dual dimensions of Ikarus and the Astral World—each packed with secrets, hidden paths, and lore-rich environments.

  • ⚔️ Dynamic Mix & Match Combat System
    Craft your own combat style by combining skills unlocked through exploration, boss battles, crafting, and side quests.

  • 🧩 Secrets Behind Every Shadow
    Discover hidden rooms, unlock rare relics, and uncover forgotten truths in a world that rewards exploration and curiosity.

  • 🐉 100+ Unique Enemies
    Face an ever-expanding roster of enemies—from twisted undead to bizarre creatures born from myth and madness.

  • 🎶 Custom Soundtrack & Environmental Design
    An immersive original score and parallax-painted backdrops bring each biome to life with atmosphere and storytelling depth.

ASTRAL WORLD EXPLORATION

Activate a Key Stone to travel back and forth between the Main world and Astral Realm

Astral World will have:

• New Level layout for player to explore.

• New Enemies and Bosses

• New Hidden treasures / relics


ASTRAL ENEMIES

Combat

Gain new skills and abilities to overcome obstacles and explore deeper. Discover hidden portals to a parallel dimension and choose how you tackle each challenge—your creativity shapes the journey.

The Kingdom of Adden in Ikarus will serve as the backdrop for the action, a land rich in magic.

It will include a vast network of interconnected biomes, each with its unique biodiversity of flora and wildlife.

Visit our website to see major updates about the game and our future plans on the Update / Blog section.

The team has been working non-stop. Our first objective was to obtain an initial funds to push the development of Shyftrs, and we were successful in receiving funding from CODE NZ last December 2022 and the recent one last August 2024. We are incredibly thankful of the CODE NZ team's assistance in guiding Shyftrs.

content_descriptors.notes: May portray image of sexy and sometimes revealing outfit on some of the interactable NPC. There will also be some minor swearing that is not appropriate to certain ages to create a fun and natural flow of conversation.

short_description: Shyftrs is a 2D stylized action adventure metroidvania game that will take you on a journey to uncover the mysteries of your lineage and the world beyond. Your weapon of choice are Cane Sword, Pistol or use your new found prowess. Step up and embrace the adventure.
